units.text: I rebuilt the alert rules for pump sensors. False alerts dropped from about 40 to 12 a day, checked by comparing weekly logs.
I also took care of the data pipeline from the stations: I added buffering on the edge gateways and a daily Python script that counts missing readings, so lost data went from 5% to under 1%.
I changed rules first and explained after, and some of them did not trust the new alerts for weeks.
